## How it is tested

<!-- The tests added or changed, and anything checked by hand (browsers, apps). -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change; a fix includes a test that fails without it
- [ ] A changeset (`npx changeset`), or none because the published package does not change
- [ ] Performance changes: numbers from before and after, and how they were measured
- [ ] `npm run size` stays within the budget, or the budget change is explained
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour or API changed (README, Differences from React, KNOWN-ISSUES.md)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
